encryption_algorithm.title: Encryption Algorithm
encryption_algorithm.description: The symmetric encryption algorithm used for full-disk or file-level encryption on the device.

encryption_key_length_bits.title: Encryption Key Length (bits)
encryption_key_length_bits.description: The key length in bits used by the encryption algorithm for full-disk or file-level encryption.

encryption_mode_of_operation.title: Encryption Mode of Operation
encryption_mode_of_operation.description: The block cipher mode of operation used with the encryption algorithm (e.g., XTS, CBC, ECB).

pre_boot_auth_enabled.title: Pre-Boot Authentication Enabled
pre_boot_auth_enabled.description: Indicates whether pre-boot authentication (PBA) is configured and enforced, requiring valid credentials before the OS loads and encrypted volumes are unlocked.

auth_factor_type.title: Pre-Boot Authentication Factor Type
auth_factor_type.description: The type of credential used at pre-boot: PIN/passphrase (user-supplied), smart card (hardware token), TPM-only (no user input), or TPM+PIN (TPM-bound key with user PIN). TPM-only provides weaker protection against physical attacks.

external_boot_prevented.title: Boot from External Media Prevented
external_boot_prevented.description: Indicates whether the device firmware (UEFI/BIOS) is configured to prevent booting from external media (USB, optical drives, network PXE), and whether the firmware configuration is password-protected.

tpm_present_and_enabled.title: TPM Present and Enabled
tpm_present_and_enabled.description: Indicates whether a TPM (Trusted Platform Module) chip is present and enabled on the device, providing hardware-rooted key storage.

disk_encryption_tpm_key_protector_active.title: Disk Encryption TPM Key Protector Active
disk_encryption_tpm_key_protector_active.description: Indicates whether the full-disk or file-level encryption solution is configured to use TPM as a key protector, binding decryption keys to the TPM and measured boot state.

secure_boot_enabled.title: Secure Boot Enabled
secure_boot_enabled.description: Indicates whether Secure Boot is enabled, ensuring the boot chain is cryptographically verified and PCR measurements reflect an untampered boot state used for TPM key sealing.

primary_volume_encryption_enabled.title: Primary Volume Encryption Enabled
primary_volume_encryption_enabled.description: Whether the primary OS/boot volume is encrypted using full-disk or volume-level encryption (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS).

swap_hibernate_encryption_enabled.title: Swap and Hibernate File Encryption Enabled
swap_hibernate_encryption_enabled.description: Whether swap space and hibernate files are encrypted, preventing residual sensitive data from being read at rest outside the primary encrypted volume.

removable_media_encryption_policy.title: Removable Media Encryption Policy
removable_media_encryption_policy.description: Policy enforcement level for encryption on removable media (USB drives, external storage).

temp_file_location_on_encrypted_volume.title: Temporary Files Reside on Encrypted Volume
temp_file_location_on_encrypted_volume.description: Whether OS and application temporary file directories (%TEMP%, /tmp, /var/tmp) reside on an encrypted volume rather than an unencrypted partition.

key_escrow_service_configured.title: Key Escrow Service Configured
key_escrow_service_configured.description: Whether an enterprise key escrow or management service (e.g., Active Directory/MBAM, MDM escrow, AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault) is configured to receive and store encryption keys from managed devices.

key_retrieval_requires_authorization.title: Key Retrieval Requires Authorization
key_retrieval_requires_authorization.description: Whether retrieval of escrowed keys is gated by an authorization workflow (e.g., role-based access, helpdesk ticket approval, audit logging of access), preventing unauthorized personnel from obtaining keys.

devices_with_escrowed_keys_percent.title: Percentage of Managed Devices with Escrowed Keys
devices_with_escrowed_keys_percent.description: The percentage of managed encrypted devices that have successfully uploaded their encryption keys to the centralized escrow service.

encryption_enforcement_status.title: Encryption Enforcement Status
encryption_enforcement_status.description: Current encryption compliance state of the device as reported by MDM or endpoint management platform, indicating whether full-disk or file-level encryption is active and enforced.

mdm_encryption_reporting_active.title: MDM Encryption Reporting Active
mdm_encryption_reporting_active.description: Indicates whether the device is enrolled in an MDM or endpoint management platform that actively reports encryption status and maintains an audit trail of encryption state changes.

encryption_coverage_scope.title: Encryption Coverage Scope
encryption_coverage_scope.description: Defines whether encryption protects the full disk, specific volumes, or only specific files, establishing the breadth of cryptographic protection on the device.

remote_wipe_enabled.title: Remote Wipe Enabled
remote_wipe_enabled.description: Indicates whether the remote wipe capability is enabled and configured for managed devices, allowing administrators to trigger a full device wipe when a device is lost, stolen, or decommissioned.

encryption_key_revocation_supported.title: Encryption Key Revocation Supported
encryption_key_revocation_supported.description: Indicates whether the MDM or encryption management platform supports remote invalidation or escrow-based revocation of encryption keys (e.g., FileVault personal recovery key escrow, BitLocker key rotation via MDM).

mdm_enrollment_coverage.title: MDM Enrollment Coverage
mdm_enrollment_coverage.description: Describes the scope of device enrollment in the MDM system that enforces remote wipe and key revocation policies.

wipe_policy_trigger_configured.title: Automated Wipe Policy Trigger Configured
wipe_policy_trigger_configured.description: Indicates whether an automated or policy-driven trigger (e.g., compliance policy violation, device reported lost/stolen) is configured to initiate remote wipe or key revocation without requiring manual administrator intervention.

mdm_encryption_policy_enforced.title: MDM/GPO Encryption Policy Enforced
mdm_encryption_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether an MDM profile or Group Policy Object actively enforces encryption requirements and prevents users from disabling encryption controls on the device.

encryption_compliance_state.title: Encryption Compliance State
encryption_compliance_state.description: The current compliance state of the device's encryption configuration as reported by the MDM or policy management system.

drift_remediation_enabled.title: Automated Drift Remediation Enabled
drift_remediation_enabled.description: Indicates whether the MDM or policy system is configured to automatically remediate devices that fall out of compliant encryption state, rather than only alerting.

removable_media_encryption_enforced.title: Removable Media Encryption Enforced
removable_media_encryption_enforced.description: Whether a policy or technical control actively enforces encryption on all data written to USB drives and external storage devices.

removable_media_encryption_scope.title: Encryption Scope for Removable Media
removable_media_encryption_scope.description: Defines the breadth of encryption coverage applied to removable media: whether all removable devices are covered, only approved/whitelisted devices, or none.

read_restriction_to_authorized_systems.title: Read Restriction to Authorized Systems Only
read_restriction_to_authorized_systems.description: Whether encrypted removable media can only be decrypted and read on systems that are part of the authorized environment (e.g., domain-joined machines with the correct key management server access).

unencrypted_write_blocked.title: Unencrypted Write to Removable Media Blocked
unencrypted_write_blocked.description: Whether the endpoint control actively blocks write operations to removable media when the device is not encrypted or cannot be encrypted.
